research_findings: Identified that AdaptiveCoachDemo.tsx was using a useRef for preferReducedMotion but reading it directly during render.
Recognized this as a React strict mode anti-pattern that leads to dangling references and potentially stale UI states, contradicting best practices documented in project journals.
next_steps_for_next_run: Investigate replacing other instances of useRef used in render paths across the application.
Implement a global rate limiter for Waitlist actions (identified TODO in waitlist.ts).
